name: Air Purifier
definition: A portable household room air cleaner that draws indoor air through a model-specific filter system with a fan and returns treated air to the room; this profile excludes whole-building ventilation and unsupported health outcomes.
includedScope: Portable household room air cleaners using fan-driven filtration
Models with documented particle and optional gas or odor filter stages
excludedScope: Whole-building HVAC filtration and outdoor air-cleaning claims
Industrial dust collectors and local exhaust systems
Unverified health, sterilization, room-size or replacement-filter compatibility claims
primaryApplications: Supplemental particle reduction in occupied household rooms
Model-approved odor or gas reduction where a documented sorbent stage is fitted
Portable room-by-room use within declared operating conditions
headline: Air purifier airflow, filters, CADR, room fit and buyer checks
description: This profile separates inlet, sensing, particle filtration, sorbent stages, fan delivery, CADR method, acoustics and replacement filters so buyers can compare exact portable room air cleaners without treating room-size labels as universal performance.
metaDescription: Air purifier guide covering CADR, room size, filters, airflow, noise, models, standards and replacement-filter checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not medical, infection-control, ventilation, fire, chemical-exposure or indoor-air-quality advice. Source control and outdoor-air ventilation remain separate decisions. Confirm the exact regional model, contaminant, CADR method, room, filter number, replacement interval, electrical supply and safety instructions.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Portable household fan-filter room air cleaner
keyFacts.evidence: EPA, IEC and manufacturer sources distinguish portable room air cleaners and their model-specific filtration.
keyFacts.scope: Portable household devices; HVAC and industrial collectors excluded.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match contaminant, CADR method, room, sound, filter number and replacement plan
keyFacts.evidence: Official sources publish different CADR methods, room calculations and exact replacement filters.
keyFacts.scope: Exact model, market and use conditions.

systemFlow.name: Air intake and sensing
systemFlow.componentFamily: Cabinet inlet, prefilter, particulate or gas sensors and controller
systemFlow.role: Admits room air and controls fan response where automatic sensing is provided.
systemFlow.evidence: Official product pages identify model-specific inlets, prefilters and sensor systems.
systemFlow.scope: Exact sensor set and operating mode.

systemFlow.name: Particle and gas treatment
systemFlow.componentFamily: Fine-particle filter and optional activated-carbon or other sorbent stage
systemFlow.role: Captures source-declared particles and, where documented, selected gases or odors.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturers publish different combined and separate filter arrangements.
systemFlow.scope: Named filter and source-stated challenge; no universal removal claim.

systemFlow.name: Fan and discharge
systemFlow.componentFamily: Motor, fan, duct, outlet and speed control
systemFlow.role: Moves treated air back into the room at a model-specific flow and sound level.
systemFlow.evidence: Official pages publish model-specific CADR, airflow, power or sound values.

variants.name: Particle-focused room air cleaner
variants.taskScale: Supplemental treatment of one occupied room
variants.operatorRelationship: User positions the unit and selects manual or automatic fan operation
variants.spaceConstraints: Inlet and outlet clearance, outlet location, noise and floor area
variants.limitations: Filter grade alone does not establish delivered room cleaning.
variants.evidence: AHAM, EPA and manufacturer pages emphasize clean-air delivery and placement.

variants.name: Particle-plus-sorbent air cleaner
variants.taskScale: Supplemental particle and source-declared odor or gas reduction
variants.operatorRelationship: User maintains multiple or combined filter stages
variants.spaceConstraints: Filter depth, airflow resistance and replacement storage
variants.limitations: Activated carbon presence does not establish capacity for every gas.
variants.evidence: Samsung, Dyson, Shark and Sharp document model-specific filter systems.
variants.scope: Named filter and claimed challenge only.

performanceMetrics.name: Clean Air Delivery Rate
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Source-declared rate of cleaned air for a named particle challenge under a defined test
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Particle type, standard, fan setting and units must match
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare CADR values from unlike methods or use one value for gases.
performanceMetrics.evidence: AHAM defines CADR while manufacturers identify model values and methods.

performanceMetrics.name: Room-size recommendation
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: A calculation based on CADR, assumed ceiling, air changes and use case
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Area claims can use different air-change or regional methods
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Maximum area is not a universal performance rating.
performanceMetrics.evidence: EPA explains room sizing and Philips qualifies its published area method.
performanceMetrics.scope: Actual room volume and target air-change rate.

performanceMetrics.name: Sound and power
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Operating impact at a named speed or mode
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Minimum, maximum and test position differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A sleep-mode number does not represent maximum clean-air delivery.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official pages publish model-specific sound and wattage values.

applicationFit.application: Supplemental particle reduction in one room
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Size from verified CADR, room volume and target air changes, then check noise at the required speed.
applicationFit.assessment: Size from verified CADR, room volume and target air changes, then check noise at the required speed.
applicationFit.basis: Room leakage, mixing, source intensity, placement and fan speed affect delivery.
applicationFit.limitations: No portable unit substitutes automatically for source control or required ventilation.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Measure the room and run particle and sound observations at the intended setting.
applicationFit.evidence: EPA and AHAM explain sizing and CADR while product pages provide model values.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Obtain the sorbent medium, mass, target compound and replacement basis in writing.
applicationFit.assessment: Obtain the sorbent medium, mass, target compound and replacement basis in writing.
applicationFit.basis: Gas removal depends on compound, concentration, sorbent capacity, contact time and environment.
applicationFit.limitations: Particle CADR and HEPA wording do not establish gas removal.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Prioritize source control and conduct a qualified task-specific assessment.
applicationFit.evidence: EPA distinguishes particle and gas-removal considerations; manufacturers identify optional carbon stages.

componentStack.name: Inlet, prefilter and sensors
componentStack.role: Admit room air, intercept coarse debris and inform control logic where fitted.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages document different sensing and prefilter configurations.

componentStack.name: Particle and sorbent filters
componentStack.role: Capture source-declared particles and optional odors or gases.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers identify exact model filter assemblies.
componentStack.scope: No cross-model fit or universal removal claim.

componentStack.name: Fan, outlet and controller
componentStack.role: Deliver treated air and regulate speed, display and connectivity.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages publish model-specific delivery and controls.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Reduce a named particle load in one room
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Matched-method CADR, room volume, speed and sound
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by maximum room area or filter grade alone
procurementDecisions.assessment: Calculate the target delivery and trial the required fan setting in the actual room.
procurementDecisions.basis: Clean-air delivery, room mixing, source and occupancy interact.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No room-size label guarantees an exposure or health outcome.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Document room volume, target air changes, CADR basis, sound and measured trend.
procurementDecisions.evidence: EPA and AHAM provide sizing context; manufacturers publish model data.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Control lifecycle filter cost and availability
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Exact filter code, stages, interval, price and seal
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming family labels, appearance or dimensions prove fit
procurementDecisions.assessment: Price the verified replacement schedule for the exact model.
procurementDecisions.basis: Cartridge construction, seals and controller reset differ.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Source-stated intervals depend on use and do not guarantee future supply.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain filter codes, five-year availability and replacement instructions in writing.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official pages identify model-specific filters and maintenance.

engineeringChecks.reason: Blocked airflow, heat sources, moisture or unsuitable power can affect safe operation and delivery.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Follow the exact safety and clearance instructions and preserve required outdoor-air ventilation.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC safety scope, EPA guidance and manufacturer manuals define boundaries.
engineeringChecks.scope: Exact appliance, room and local requirements.

engineeringChecks.reason: Incorrect fit, orientation or overdue replacement can bypass or restrict the intended air path.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Verify the exact filter number, seals, installation direction and reset procedure.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturer pages identify model-specific filter assemblies.
engineeringChecks.scope: Exact model and genuine documented replacement.

standards.name: AHAM AC-1 room air cleaner performance method and CADR program
standards.applicability: Defines industry measurement and certification context for particle clean-air delivery rates.
standards.evidence: AHAM explains CADR and its verified room-air-cleaner program.
standards.scope: Only products and particle ratings declared under the named program.

standards.applicability: Particular safety requirements for air-cleaning appliances.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the standard scope and edition.
standards.scope: Confirm regional conformity and exact product classification.
